releaseNotes:
• Smart Bangla Voice Soundbox Announcement: speaks payment provider and amount in natural Bengali upon successful webhook delivery (with on/off toggle and audio test button)
• Local WiFi Web Dashboard (Port 8080): live in-browser desktop dashboard over local WiFi for real-time transaction viewing, stats, and 1-click CSV download without cloud dependencies
• Device Health & Battery Guard: real-time battery status with emergency alert notification if battery drops below 15% when unplugged
• Webhook Speed & Latency Benchmark: live response time card on Dashboard displaying average ms, fastest, slowest, and real-time health rating
• 24/7 Automated Forwarding System: maximum broadcast priority (2147483647), partial CPU WakeLock, FIFO queue persistence, and boot auto-revival ensure 100% automated SMS forwarding
